note: The script asks for the hook text, one lower third, two top text lines and a key-words stack, so 5 graphics and the end card. Rows 00:10–00:21 and 00:21–00:30 are captions only. The CASS logo file is not in endcards/ yet, so the end card types CASS until it is added.

mg.title: Hook text

text.main: We're never just too far gone.

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: We're never just too far gone. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third.

mg.title: Lower third
mg.cue: Lower third at 00:03 for 3 s, lower left above the captions: Gabriela / Shelter Support, The Haven.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:03 for 3 s, after the hook text goes out. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line Shelter Support, The Haven under the name.

mg.title: Top text
mg.cue: Top text at 00:35 for 2.5 s, top band, as she says it: there's a root behind it.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:35 as she says it. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Key words
mg.cue: Key words at 00:42, stacked in the top band as she says them: an apartment / a job / tears of joy.
mg.use: Start at 00:42 so each phrase lands as she says it. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Top text

text.main: I didn't allow my circumstances to dictate who I was

mg.cue: Top text at 00:55 for 3 s, top band, as she says it: I didn't allow my circumstances to dictate who I was.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:55 as she says it. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: CASS logo, then the line For more information visit cassaz.org.
mg.src: No CASS end card or logo file is in the repo yet (endcards/index.json has no CASS entry, checked 3 Nov 2026), so CASS is typed. Line from the script's end card row (cassaz.org, the CASS end card line in the client file); colours from the CASS brand (navy #2C2B77, white).
mg.use: After the last line at 01:01. Hold it to the end. Swap in the CASS logo once it is in the repo.
